title: Chapter 405: Split Historical Figures Into Two Parts
content:
Chapter 405: Split Historical Figures Into Two Parts

"Other gods and concubines dare not say that Chao Naqiu's great Shen Jueqiu is quite effective."

Ye Zijin stroked his slightly bulging belly with great satisfaction. When Heifu traveled to the county in February, he went to Chaona County. On the order of Qin Shihuang, he worshiped one of the three witches worshiped by Qin people for generations on the bank of Chaonaqiu. During the "Great Shen Jueqiu", I also secretly added some personal sacrifices to pray for my children...

Decades ago, during the fierce war between Qin and Chu, King Qin Huiwen asked Wu Zhu to carve three stone drum inscriptions in order to seek help from the gods, namely "Information on Wu Xian", "Inscription on Yatuo" and "Inscription on Da Shen Jueqiu", collectively known as "Curse Chuwen", that war ended with Qin's victory. From then on, there will be sacrifices to the three witches every year.

Coincidentally, after Hei Fu came back and worked hard with his wife for several months, the results were achieved. Last month, Ye was taken to the hospital and confirmed to be pregnant. This immediately made Hei Fu happy, while Ye Zijin felt that this was Heifu's request for a child was answered in Chao Naqiu.

Unexpectedly, there would be a follow-up to that county sacrificial ceremony. Qin Shihuang asked the ministers to discuss whether the Li Mu Temple in Yanmen should be abolished, and asked Hei Fu. The reason was that Hei Fu had been renovating the prostitution temple in Beidi County in the first half of the year. , quite effective.

"It has no effect."

Hei Fu secretly complained: "How can it be possible to ban folk sacrifices with a decree? Even two thousand years later, local temples, Mazu, and local gods are not everywhere."

The Chinese people's view of gods has been very utilitarian since ancient times. The five mountains and four mountains recognized by the state, no matter how grand they are, are of no use to me. I still have to offer sacrifices to the hills and rivers next to my home, because they are vital to livelihood and life.

So one size fits all is useless. What Heifu did was to discuss with the county magistrate and the Prime Minister to make those sacrifices too frequent, the sacrifices exceeding the rank and status, or causing harm to the people like the witch in "Ximen Leopard Rules Ye" Some of the obscene temples were cancelled, while the rest turned a blind eye.

Similar situations are happening in all counties across the country, but Li Mu Temple in Yanmen County is indeed a special case because it is related to historical issues...

Ye Zijin also felt that this was really a difficult problem. Neither Li Si nor Meng Tian could afford to offend him.

However, she had always had confidence in her husband's wisdom. When she saw him chewing on the writing brush and thinking, she did not disturb him, leaving only a cup of sour plum soup to relieve the heat. Because it contained brown sugar instead of white sugar, the color and taste were strange.

In the eyes of the Qin people, Li Mu can be said to be "the sinner who hinders the unification of the world."

In the eyes of the Zhao people, Li Mu was "a patriotic general who died unjustly to protect Zhao's independence."

The different stances determine the completely different attitudes of the people of Qin and Zhao towards Li Mu. Considering this, it is commendable that Meng Tian can respect Li Mu and insist on retaining Li Mu's temple.

However, Li Si adhered to the principle of "He is a hero and I am a enemy" and wanted to destroy all Li Mu's temples and erase the memory of Li Mu from the minds of the people of Zhao. The subsequent burning of books was also motivated by this Purpose. Legalists sometimes do things too roughly, which can be counterproductive. The more they suppress, suppress, and cover up some things, the more people will be curious about them and remember them unforgettable.

Heifu thought about later generations and found that a similar situation seemed to have occurred. The emperor of the Qing Dynasty actually worshiped Shi Kefa, who resisted the Qing Dynasty, and repaired the Yue Fei Temple with great fanfare. Although he knew it was an act, Qing could do this. If Qin could not perform as well as the Qing Dynasty, then it would be Too cheap.

However, this matter cannot only be judged by right or wrong. Heifu was supported by Li Si and his son, but Meng Tian will be the main force in next year's war, so he must not be offended.

He looked at the plum blossoms rising and falling in the cup, and remembered a sentence he often heard in politics classes in later generations.

“Any historical figure must be viewed in two parts!”

It is true that Li Si once defeated the Qin army and was the great enemy of Qin. But what if we do not distinguish between Qin people and Zhao people, but only count them according to the Xia?

Li Mu is a national hero who resisted the invasion of the Huns and maintained the peace of the border people of Guandai!

Following this line of thinking, Heifu thought for a while and sneered: "If you think I will fall into this pit, you are looking down on me. Just be optimistic. My answer will not cause any harm to Qing Li Si or Meng Tian." , and it can satisfy His Majesty!"

…

Qin Shihuang would not stay where he was and wait for the ministers to discuss it. He quickly left Mayi and patrolled eastward along Yeshui (Sanggan River), arrived at Daijun, and then traveled south for hundreds of miles. At the junction of Hengshan County and Hengshan County, people worship Hengshan Mountain, which is recognized by the Qin Dynasty as one of the "Twelve Mountains".

It was the end of June, the weather was fine, and Qin Shihuang was able to climb the mountain along the mountain road opened by the Zhao people.

Although Hengshan is located in the north, there are many relics, such as the "Wu Shi Terrace". It is said that in the Spring and Autumn Period, Zhao Yang, the son of Zhao Jian, summoned his sons and said, "I will hide a treasure talisman on Mount Heng. The winner will be rewarded.”

So, all the disciples searched for the treasure talisman in Hengshan Mountain, but they all came back in vain. Only the least favored youngest son Zhao Wuxie said: "I have obtained the treasure talisman." But he was also empty-handed.

Zhao Jianzi asked him to explain the situation, and Zhao Wuxie said: "With the danger of Mount Hengshan, if we attack Dai, the country of Dai can be owned by the Zhao family!" Zhao Jianzi thought about this, so he deposed Prince Bolu and made Wuxie his heir.

Standing on the Wuji Platform, Qin Shihuang saw thousands of mountains and mountains, which were strange and unpredictable. To the north of the mountains was Dai and to the south was Zhao Di.

"Although Zhao Xiangzi was greedy and shameless, marrying his sister to the king of Dai and deceiving her to kill her at a banquet, but he annexed Dai Rong and opened up the Hu territory, which can be regarded as a contribution to Zhu Xia."

Although he didn't like the Zhao family, Qin Shihuang had to admit that both Qin and Zhao had the blood of Ying, and they seemed to have a drive to expand outwards. Qin dominated Xirong and expanded thousands of miles, and Zhao Xiangzi and King Zhao Wuling also Continuously defeated Dai, Zhongshan, Loufan and other Rong states, and expanded thousands of miles north.

But Qin Shihuang didn't take it too seriously, because the territory he would open up would be several times or ten times that of Zhao Xiangzi and King Wuling!

After staying in Hengshan for several days, Qin Shihuang went north to Dai City, inspected Gaoliusei, which is adjacent to the Xiongnu and Donghu, and then passed through Pingcheng. In mid-July, he arrived at Shanwu, the capital of Yanmen County...

This tour lasted exactly one month, and the reply from Hei Fu from Beidi County was also sent to Qin Shihuang's case.

Qin Shihuang opened it and took a look, and found that Heifu declared sternly at the beginning that Tingwei was right, if the law is not established, chaos is the way to perish! Qin officials must abide by the law and enforce the law strictly, and folk prostitution must not be tolerated!

Li Zheng and Wu Lao, who hold prostitution temples, can be punished with two grades each. In this way, Li Zheng and Wu Lao will actively stop private sacrifices among the people.

Qin Shihuang shook his head. Of course he could see that Hei Fu was not trying to offend Li Si, but was promoting his political correctness!

However, Heifu then changed the topic and talked about the story of Dayu's flood control, "It is better to block the flood than to dredge it." He thought that what General Meng Tian said was right. The people in Daibei missed Li Mu because Li Mu defended the people against the enemy. When the Huns invaded, this memory is difficult to erase. Therefore, it is not enough to just ban private sacrifices among the people, but also to give people a place to vent.

Hei Fu mentioned the "Loyal Soldiers Cemetery" in Nanjun and Beidi. Buried there were Qin soldiers and loyal soldiers who died in the unification since Qin Shihuang ascended the throne, but it was difficult to identify their bones. They were also inscribed "Eternal Immortal" by the county captain. A big word...

"However, the ancients said that Rong, Di, jackals and wolves cannot be disgusted, and the Xia are close to each other and cannot be abandoned. In my opinion, the war between the Xia crown and belt countries is actually a fight between brothers. Now the sea is unified, and the seven countries are one family. , when there are no longer distinctions between people of Qi, people of Zhao, people of Yan, people of Chu, people of Han, and people of Wei, all the people in the world are the people of Qin, and they can also be called people of China!"

Of course, the Qin people recognized Hua and Xia, and called the children born between Qin and Rong Di "Xia Zi" to distinguish them from the pure descendants of Rong Di. There is nothing wrong with Heifu's statement.

"Brothers are jealous of each other within the wall, and they resist their insults from outside. Now that the crown and belt country has been unified by Your Majesty, the civil war has ended, but the external war will begin..."

"The Xiongnu, Donghu people, and the Yi and Di people were greedy and profit-loving. They were sent to the left and had beast-like hearts. They had different clothes, different customs, different diets, and different languages from China. They lived in the northern wilderness where the cold dew hung. Grass follows the livestock, and hunting and hunting make a living. They are separated by valleys, and Yong is covered with sand curtains. Therefore, the sky and the earth are separated from the outside and the inside."

"Your Majesty wants to avenge the people of the world for the hundreds of years of harassment caused by the Hu Rong, and the Di and Qiang from there. No one dares not to come and enjoy it, and no one dares not to come to the king. Just like Qi Huan and Guan Zhong were in the north of the Yan State when the Shan Rong invaded. There are princes and ministers Then, this battle is no longer a battle between the Qin people in Guanxi, nor a battle between several counties in northern Xinjiang, but a battle between the people of the world!"

"Your Majesty, if you want to use all your strength to defeat the Huns, why not build a new temple in the border county, named 'Jingbian Temple', to worship the outstanding people of Xia who have opened up the territory for thousands of years to resist the invasion of Rong and Di." ! Guan Zhong of Qi, Youyu of Qin, and Li Mu of Zhao can all be among them, so that the commander-in-chief of the four seasons in the counties and the people can worship the kings. This will make the head of Guizhou know that all the Xia are really one family, and Rong and Di are foreign enemies!"

The entire article ends with a sincere statement:

"Honor the king and repel the barbarians, and save the Xia within and the barbarians outside! This is my wish!"

"The Xia within and the Barbarians outside are well said!"

After Qin Shihuang finished reading it in one breath, he looked at Li Si, then at Meng Tian, and Zhao Gao beside him. He sighed and gave the memorial to them. Then, he said something that made Zhao Gao secretly happy and Li Si shocked, What surprised Meng Tian:

"Heifu, you have never let me down!"
